verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.morphllm.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of doc pages such as introduction.md, which point agents to the full documentation index. The llms.txt also links a machine-readable model and pricing feed, and many doc pages are served as .md. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt bundle, and no independent or community report of agents actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.morphllm.com/llms.txt # Morph API Documentation
Fetch the complete documentation index at: https://docs.morphllm.com/llms.txt
For machine-readable models, limits and these list prices, fetch https://www.morphllm.com/api/models/json?prices=list
